conceptual_change: Introduce a regime-aware volatility filter to refine mean reversion entries by penalizing signals during high-volatility expansion periods.
rationale: The failure analysis suggests the prior attempt at a z-score volatility filter was unexecutable due to implementation constraints. By framing the filter using existing primitives—specifically a rolling_std of close location to identify relative volatility regimes—we can create a robust, testable logic gate for mean-reversion signals.
